title: Nab-paclitaxel fused with the de novo designed receptor binder exhibits enhanced tumor targeting and therapeutic efficacy.
authors: Qian, Yuanying; Yan, Weikang; Xu, Fan; Liu, Yali; Chen, Fabao; Lu, Yue; Zhang, Zihan; Gu, Ao; Yu, Ruobing; Fang, Zhen; Yu, Yang; Li, Maolan; Cao, Longxing; Liu, Yingbin; He, Yongning
journal: Journal of controlled release : official journal of the Controlled Release Society
one_liner_zh: 该文利用AI设计的蛋白结合物修饰白蛋白紫杉醇，实现靶向肿瘤递送，虽涉及蛋白设计但核心是药物递送而非蛋白质结构计算建模，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Chemotherapy has been widely used in cancer treatment, but most of the chemotherapeutic drugs rely mainly on passive accumulation due to lack of target specificity, which may lead to systemic toxicity and limited clinical utility. Recent advances in artificial intelligence-based protein design provide new opportunities for developing precision therapeutics. Here we modify the albumin-bound paclitaxel (Nab-PTX), one of the most widely used drugs in chemotherapies, by applying the fusion proteins of albumin with the de novo designed protein binders targeting human EGFR or HER2. The resulting particles, EGFRmb-Nab-PTX and HER2mb-Nab-PTX, retain the similar physicochemical properties of Nab-PTX while acquiring the receptor-specific binding capacities. The in vitro assays show that both binder-modified Nab-PTX particles have increased uptake and inhibitory effects significantly in the cancer cell lines with high receptor expression levels. Furthermore, the data from a xenograft model, including tumor growth, excised tumor analysis, organ histology, and fluorescence imaging, show that the binder-modified Nab-PTX enhances tumor accumulation, improves tumor suppression, and may reduce off-target exposure compared with the conventional Nab-PTX, suggesting that they may have promising clinical potential in cancer treatment. Overall, this strategy provides an adaptable modular platform for generating albumin-based chemotherapeutic drugs with target specificities, which can be readily customized with diverse target binders to enable precise cancer therapies.
abstract_zh: 化疗在癌症治疗中被广泛应用，但大多数化疗药物由于缺乏靶向特异性，主要依赖被动积累，这可能导致全身毒性并限制其临床效用。基于人工智能的蛋白质设计的最新进展为开发精准治疗提供了新机遇。在此，我们通过将白蛋白与靶向人EGFR或HER2的从头设计蛋白结合物融合，对白蛋白结合型紫杉醇（Nab-PTX）——化疗中最广泛使用的药物之一——进行修饰。所得颗粒EGFRmb-Nab-PTX和HER2mb-Nab-PTX保留了与Nab-PTX相似的理化性质，同时获得了受体特异性结合能力。体外实验表明，两种结合物修饰的Nab-PTX颗粒在高受体表达水平的癌细胞系中显著增加了摄取和抑制效果。此外，来自异种移植模型的数据，包括肿瘤生长、切除肿瘤分析、器官组织学和荧光成像，显示与常规Nab-PTX相比，结合物修饰的Nab-PTX增强了肿瘤积累、改善了肿瘤抑制，并可能减少脱靶暴露，表明其在癌症治疗中可能具有临床潜力。总体而言，该策略提供了一个适应性模块化平台，用于生成具有靶向特异性的白蛋白基化疗药物，可通过多种靶向结合物轻松定制，以实现精准癌症治疗。
